{"decision": "push", "reason": "页面描述了一个具体的小众工具：输入任意美国地址即可生成场地底图（地块线、等高线、土壤、洪水区、湿地、3D体量），可直接导入AutoCAD、SketchUp、Civil 3D等，免注册，且给出了奥林匹亚滨水地块的示例PDF。这是针对建筑/场地设计专业人士的具体垂直工具，有一定的巧思和专业完成度。"}

verdict.reasoning: Every claim in the reason matches the page: base plans from any US address, parcel lines, contours, soils, flood zones, wetlands, 3D massing, AutoCAD/SketchUp/Civil 3D export, no account needed, and the Olympia waterfront example PDF. It names concrete features and a target user (architects and site designers), which supports the push decision.
